scripts.check: pnpm -r check && pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm check:worker && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:secrets
scripts.check:worker: uv run --directory apps/worker ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/worker ruff format --check . && uv run --directory apps/worker pyright
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run --directory apps/worker pytest -q
